covered_actors: providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk
compliance_deadlines: 2025-08-02: Providers placing general-purpose AI models on the EU market must comply with applicable AI Act obligations and notify the AI Office of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk without delay.
2026-08-02: The European Commission will begin enforcing full compliance with all AI Act obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models with fines.
2027-08-02: General-purpose AI models placed on the market before 2 August 2025 must comply with AI Act obligations.
penalties_summary: From 2 August 2026 onwards, the European Commission will enforce full compliance with all AI Act obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models through fines. During the first year from 2 August 2025, the AI Office will treat signatories who have not yet fully implemented all Code commitments as acting in good faith and collaborate with them rather than reproaching them for AI Act violations.
implementation_notes: Official European Commission Q&A explaining the voluntary General-Purpose AI Code of Practice (covering Transparency, Copyright, and Safety and Security chapters), which does not impose new obligations beyond the AI Act. Notes the AI Act's 10^25 FLOPs presumption for systemic risk, upcoming Commission guidelines clarifying scope, adequacy assessment by Member States and the Commission, and AI Office review of the Code at least every two years.
